hero.subtitle: Cultivating high-yield, eco-friendly agricultural operations in Portugal, focusing on premium produce, soil health, and sustainable supply chains.

about.paragraph1: King Agriculture represents our commitment to responsible land management and agricultural self-sufficiency. By employing modern farming technologies alongside eco-friendly practices, we produce top-tier fruits, vegetables, and crops.
about.paragraph2: Our crops directly feed into King Supermarkets and King Cash & Carry networks, guaranteeing that our customers enjoy genuine farm-to-table freshness.
bulletPoints: Eco-friendly irrigation and water management techniques
Direct integration into King retail & wholesale channels
Continuous soil testing and organic enrichment

items.title: Horticultural Crops
items.description: Fresh tomatoes, peppers, cucumbers, and brassicas grown in ideal Portuguese climate conditions.

items.title: Orchard Fruits & Citrus
items.description: Sweet citrus, apples, pears, and stone fruits cultivated for optimal taste and nutrition.

items.title: Arable Farming
items.description: Sustainable grain and fodder production supporting regional agriculture and livestock.

items.title: Controlled-Environment Produce
items.description: High-efficiency greenhouse farming ensuring year-round supply of fresh greens.

steps.title: Soil Prep & Nutrition
steps.description: Enriching the fields with natural green manure and biological compost to ensure high trace mineral content.

steps.title: Drip Irrigation Planting
steps.description: Sowing premium non-GMO seeds alongside sensor-driven drip lines to deliver water straight to root bulbs.

steps.title: Organic Plant Protection
steps.description: Managing pests using natural predators and plant extract sprays instead of synthetic chemicals.

steps.title: Careful Harvesting
steps.description: Hand-picking delicate fruits and automated crop harvesting during cool morning hours to lock in freshness.

supportItems.title: Water Recycling
supportItems.description: Runoff capture channels and storage reservoirs that recycle up to 40% of irrigation water.

supportItems.title: Solar Powered Wells
supportItems.description: Powering farm water pumps and sorting facilities using clean, local photovoltaic solar arrays.

items.title: Land Stewardship
items.description: Preserving soil vitality and local biodiversity for future generations.

items.title: Precision Irrigation
items.description: Drip irrigation and sensor-driven water conservation practices.

items.title: Full Traceability
items.description: 100% transparent supply chain tracking from seed planted to retail shelf.

items.question: Where are King Agriculture farms located?
items.answer: Our agricultural estates are situated across key fertile agricultural regions in Portugal.

items.question: Are King Agriculture products certified sustainable?
items.answer: Yes, our farms comply with European agricultural safety standards and sustainable farming practices.
